simple.meaning: פַּרְתַּם (partam) is a Hebrew word meaning “a grandee.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פַּרְתַּם (H6579) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Esther 1:3, with occurrences in Esther, Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פַּרְתַּם (H6579) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פַּרְתַּם (H6579) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: פַּרְתַּם (partam) / H6579 is traced through Esther 1:3, Esther 6:9, Daniel 1:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
